user.title: Set up Guition Studio
user.description: Guition Studio adds a designer for Guition ESP32-S3 touch displays to the sidebar. The firmware source is the GitHub repository verified firmware releases are downloaded from.

notify.name: Show notification
notify.description: Shows a pop-up notification on a Guition display.

seconds.name: Duration
seconds.description: Seconds until it closes (0 = until tapped).

show_page.name: Show page
show_page.description: Switches a display to a specific page.

page.name: Page
page.description: Page name, page id or page number (from 1).

push_layout.name: Push layout
push_layout.description: Transfers the current draft of a display.
